focus.label: Behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD)
focus.why: The current frontier 'Neurodegenerative disease (FTD)' is still a broad category and can be refined. The predominant, early behavioral/personality change (listlessness, neglect of work, hyperreligiosity, agitation, confusion) coupled with apraxia, anosmia and a markedly reduced MMSE (7) but no aphasia (graph nodes node-2 and node-3, both supporting node-6) is the classic presentation of the behavioral variant, the most common FTD subtype; thus bvFTD is the most parsimonious refinement of the frontier.
